_about: Sentences volunteers read aloud in the Speech lab to measure recognition accuracy on their own accent. The reference text is exactly what they were asked to read.
en-IN: A primary key uniquely identifies each row and it can never be null.
In third normal form, a non key attribute must not depend on another non key attribute.
Atomicity means the whole transaction happens completely or not at all.
We use a B plus tree index because it keeps the tree shallow and reduces disk reads.
A deadlock happens when two transactions keep waiting for each other's locks forever.
Round robin scheduling gives every process a fixed time quantum in a circular queue.
Virtual memory lets a program use more memory than the physical RAM by paging to disk.
The left outer join returns all rows from the left table even when there is no match.
I would first run explain on the query to check whether it is doing a full table scan.
A semaphore is an integer counter, while a mutex can be held by only one thread at a time.
Write ahead logging records every change in the log before the data page is written.
My project was a canteen ordering app built with React, Node and PostgreSQL.
Serializable isolation prevents dirty reads, non repeatable reads and phantom reads.
To avoid overselling tickets, I would lock the row using select for update inside a transaction.
hi-en: Primary key ka matlab hai ki har row ko uniquely identify karna, aur woh null nahi ho sakta.
Deadlock tab hota hai jab do transactions ek dusre ke lock ka wait karte rehte hain.
Normalisation isliye karte hain taaki redundancy kam ho aur update anomaly na aaye.
Index se search fast hoti hai, lekin insert aur update thoda slow ho jaata hai.
Atomicity ka matlab hai ya toh poora transaction hoga ya bilkul nahi hoga.
Maine apne project mein React aur Firebase use kiya tha, aur database design maine kiya.
Agar time quantum bahut chhota ho, toh context switch ka overhead badh jaata hai.
Race condition mein dono threads ek saath same variable ko update kar dete hain.
Pehle main explain chala ke dekhunga ki query full table scan toh nahi kar rahi.
Virtual memory mein page RAM mein nahi hota toh page fault aata hai aur disk se load hota hai.
